title: Candlewicking round a 40 mm square, Size 10.0, Density Dense
description: A 40 x 40 mm square's outline sewn as Candlewicking, Size 10.0 mm, Spacing 1.0 mm, Density Dense: PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews 16 knots (4 a side) of 64 points each, 1070 needle points in its status bar. A knot has more points the larger it is: four times the quarter circle's arc over a pitch of 1.0, 0.75 or 0.5 mm (Light, Medium, Dense) plus 0.1, rounded up, and the run between knots ends with one stitch of the knot's radius, from its edge to its centre (#1236). The point counts are pinned by the design test candlewick_knots_have_pe_designs_points_at_every_size.
